requirements: Requires FTK Mod Framework 1.2.2 or later within 1.x.
1.1.0 playtest candidate. Instant Reload, pistol fit, save migration, multiplayer, and hot reload require live validation.

contentChanges: Play a fast Thief with Speed-based paired daggers and Talent-based flintlock pistols.
Thieves restore one pistol round at the start of each combat turn; pistols occupy both equipment hands.
Exploit openings and preparation with Sneak Attack; spend a turn on Slip Away.
Discover 45 equipment pieces across seven tiers, including Skeleton Key, Candle's End, and Unlost Road.
changelog: 1.1.0 playtest candidate. Bow equipment becomes original flintlock pistols, with Thief-only Instant Reload and new seven-tier coat, boot, dagger, and pistol meshes. Published bow item IDs remain stable for saved equipment; live save compatibility remains open. Promotional banner is an illustration, not a gameplay screenshot.
